correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md identifies A=k[x,y]/(x^3,y^3), J^5=0 and f^3=0, and classifies Jordan blocks from ranks (rank m_f, rank m_f^2). A coordinate automorphism sends any f with nonzero linear form to x, giving ranks (6,3). For quadratic leading Q=ax²+bxy+cy², the degree-three multiplication matrix [[b,a],[c,b]] has determinant Delta=b²-ac; degree-two and degree-four image contributions give rank 2+rank(T_Q), while f²=Delta x²y². This yields (4,1) for Delta nonzero and (3,0) for nonzero Delta-zero Q. Cubic and socle leading forms have ranks (2,0), (1,0); zero rank (0,0). The six partitions and F_{3^r} cardinalities follow by independent free coefficients; discriminant-zero quadratic cone has q² points, smooth off vertex. For f!=0, (1+f)^3=1, and the other generator 1+2f+f² has identical Jordan ranks; all order-3 normalized-unit subgroups are counted twice, yielding (q^8-1)/2. Independent direct multiplication and rank enumeration exhaust F3 all 6561 elements and reproduce multiplicities 5832,486,216,24,2,1; finite counts corroborate, not prove all fields.
